name: 19030 · Fairless Hls, PA
findings: ZIP 19030 (Fairless Hls) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19030 (Fairless Hls) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
